it: Non è stata registrata nessuna lotta.

id: \bWould you like to participate in a battle?
en: \bWould you like to participate in a battle?

id: \bDo you want to take the Level 50 challenge, or the Open Level challenge?
en: \bDo you want to take the Level 50 challenge, or the Open Level challenge?
it: \bVuoi affrontare la sfida Livello 50 o la sfida Livello Libero?

id: \bSorry, you can't participate. You need three different Pokémon to enter.
en: \bSorry, you can't participate.  You need three different Pokémon to enter.
it: \bMi spiace, non puoi partecipare.  Per iscriverti servono tre Pokémon diversi.

id: \bThey must be of a different species and hold different items.
en: \bThey must be of a different species and hold different items.
it: \bDevono essere di specie diverse e tenere strumenti diversi.

id: \bCertain exotic species, as well as eggs, are ineligible.
en: \bCertain exotic species, as well as eggs, are ineligible.
it: \bAlcune specie esotiche, così come le uova, non sono ammesse.

id: \bPlease choose the three Pokémon that will enter.
en: \bPlease choose the three Pokémon that will enter.

id: \bYou have no room for it. At least you won, though.
en: \bYou have no room for it.  At least you won, though.
it: \bNon hai spazio per tenerlo.  Almeno hai vinto, però.

id: \bWould you like to record your last battle?
en: \bWould you like to record your last battle?

id: \bWe've been waiting for you. Please come this way.
en: \bWe've been waiting for you.  Please come this way.
it: \bTi stavamo aspettando.  Da questa parte, prego.

id: \bExcuse me, but you didn't save before finishing your challenge last time.
en: \bExcuse me, but you didn't save before finishing your challenge last time.
it: \bScusa, ma l'ultima volta non hai salvato prima di terminare la sfida.

id: \bSorry, but your challenge has been canceled.
en: \bSorry, but your challenge has been canceled.
it: \bSpiacente, ma la tua sfida è stata annullata.
